scripts.deploy:firestore: npm run preflight:prod && node scripts/confirm-production.mjs && npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore --project itla-crush-cb9bd
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run preflight:prod && npm run build && node scripts/confirm-production.mjs && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project itla-crush-cb9bd
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run preflight:prod && npm run audit:prod && npm run quality && node scripts/confirm-production.mjs && npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore,hosting --project itla-crush-cb9bd
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-itla-crush "npx vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.js"
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run check:a11y && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
